system.description: Although generally reclusive, the snow ape is clever and cruel, preferring to ambush its victims whenever possible. If trapped or cornered, the snow ape fights viciously (use the morale in parentheses in this case). Although they cannot make intelligible sounds, snow apes communicate with each other using a complex sign language. In addition, snow apes often leave messages for each other using a system of stacked rocks and snowballs. Both male and female archons have the bodies like that of giant eagles, with golden-feathered wings. The male archon has a head, arms, and torso like a huge muscular man; the female has no torso, but has a dragonlike neck and three heads: two bull's heads flanking a beautiful female human's. In combat, each female's bull head may gore for 3d10 points of damage or breathe a cone of fire 10' long for 4d6 points of damage.
